# S387 — File a role's safe tool feedback as a slice

*Proposed.* First of three slices from S320. Each kept tool feedback entry gets a stable key, a repeat within a run is dropped, and an entry of kind `friction` or `deterministic-check` is filed as an unscored slice: in the registered project the tool names, else in the run's own project with the tool in the title. A `feature` entry stays kept for the second slice.

**Findings:** 2026-11-17 spec draft of S320 at f48a6154. Parsing and keeping landed in S354 (adj 325 `relay.tool-feedback`, decision `full`): `splitToolFeedback` (`internal/engine/report.go:148-171`) reads up to 3 well-formed lines per report, `routeReport` keeps them with `AddToolFeedback` (`internal/engine/round.go:922-929`), and the record holds at most 3 with no duplicate check (`internal/runrec/record.go:381-403`, `:452`). Nothing acts on them (`docs/design.md:1321-1325`). `slicercli.Client.Add` always passes `--discovered-from` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:489-505`). · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Roles already report tool feedback and ork keeps it, but no step files it (`docs/design.md:1321-1325`). slicer does not file it: s453 left "filing tool feedback as roadmap items, GitHub issues or `slicer feedback` entries" to the ork slice (`slicer show s453 --root ../slicer`, Not in this slice), and `slicer feedback` is a local, gitignored log with kinds `friction|bug|feature` and no tool field (`slicer/src/slicer/feedback.py:1-9`).

Owner decisions (2026-11-17, relay session 8d711f67): auto-file the safe kinds (adj 410 `feedback.auto-file`, `auto-safe`); safe is decided by kind (adj 411 `feedback.safe-kinds`, `by-kind`); the target is the named tool's project when it is registered in ork, else the run's own project with the tool in the title (adj 412 `feedback.target`, `registered`); ork acts on each report (adj 413 `feedback.when`, `on-report`); duplicates are caught by a stable key (adj 414 `feedback.dedupe`, `stable-key`).

What the code shows (read at f48a6154):

- An entry is `Role, Tool, Kind, Proposal, Evidence` (`internal/runrec/record.go:387-393`); Tool is free text (`internal/engine/report.go:126`).
- The model for filing is `FileLater`: `slicer add TITLE --discovered-from ITEM --key RUN-later-N`, then `slicer promote` with a Why outline, then `Filed` on the finding (`internal/engine/later.go:109-145`).
- `slicer add --help`: `--discovered-from` takes an "existing item ID"; `--key` is a "case-sensitive filing identity; retries return the existing item".
- The engine knows only its own project (`internal/engine/engine.go:48-66`); the daemon builds `Deps` in `runDeps` (`internal/daemon/runs.go:265-290`) and resolves a name with `registered` (`internal/daemon/reads.go:83`).

*Proposed:*

- Tool slug: lower case, every rune outside `[a-z0-9-]` becomes `-`, trimmed of `-`; empty becomes `tool`.
- Key: `tool-feedback-SLUG-HASH`, HASH the first 8 hex of sha256(slug, kind, proposal lower-cased with white space folded, joined by NUL).
- Within a run, `AddToolFeedback` skips an entry whose key the record already holds.
- Target: the registered project named SLUG (case-insensitive), else the run's own project. In the run's own project the title is `SLUG: PROPOSAL` when SLUG is not that project's name, and `--discovered-from ITEM` is passed; in another project no `--discovered-from` is passed and the Why names the source project, item and run.
- Filing: `slicer add TITLE --key KEY` then `slicer promote` with a Why that names the role, the run, the project, the item and the evidence. No scores. The entry gets `key`, `filed` (the item id) and `filed_at`.
- Advisory: a failure writes `file_error` on the entry and never pauses, fails or stops the run.
- Narrowest discovered-from fix: `Client.Add` passes `--discovered-from` only when the argument is not empty. `FileLater` always passes its run's item (`internal/engine/later.go:130`), so it is unchanged.

- `TestToolFeedbackKeyIsStableAndNormalized` (`internal/engine`): tools `Slicer` and `slicer` with proposals `Add  a --json flag` and `add a --json flag`, kind `friction`, give the same `tool-feedback-slicer-XXXXXXXX`; kind `feature` gives another key; tool `my tool` gives slug `my-tool`. Fails first: `ToolFeedbackKey` does not exist.
- `TestToolFeedbackTargetIsTheRegisteredToolElseTheRunsProject` (`internal/engine`): with `ork` and `slicer` registered, tool `slicer` targets slicer with no discovered-from; tool `some-cli` in a run of `ork` targets ork with title `some-cli: PROPOSAL` and discovered-from the item; tool `ork` targets ork with the bare proposal. Fails first: `ToolFeedbackTarget` does not exist.
- `TestAddToolFeedbackSkipsARepeatedKey` (`internal/runrec`): two entries with one key and a third distinct one keep two, in order. Fails first: all three are kept (`internal/runrec/record.go:397-403`).
- `TestSlicerAddOmitsAnEmptyDiscoveredFrom` (`internal/slicercli`): `Add(ctx, w, root, "T", "", "k")` runs argv with no `--discovered-from`; `Add(..., "S1", "k")` still has `--discovered-from S1`. Fails first: the flag is always sent (`internal/slicercli/write.go:495`).
- `TestToolFeedbackFrictionIsFiledInTheToolsProject` (`internal/engine`, fake slicer as in the later-finding tests): a reviewer line `tool feedback: 1. reviewer | tool: slicer | kind: friction | proposal: Print the run id on start | evidence: had to run ork status` in a run of `ork`, with `slicer` registered, runs `slicer add "Print the run id on start" --key tool-feedback-slicer-... --root SLICERPATH` and `slicer promote`; the entry has `filed`. Fails first: nothing files tool feedback.
- `TestToolFeedbackUnregisteredToolIsFiledInTheRunsProject` (`internal/engine`): `tool: some-cli`, kind `deterministic-check`, files `some-cli: PROPOSAL` in the run's project with `--discovered-from ITEM`. Fails first: no filer.
- `TestToolFeedbackFeatureIsOnlyKept` (`internal/engine`): kind `feature` makes no slicer write and the entry has `key` and no `filed`. Fails first: no route.
- `TestToolFeedbackFilingFailureDoesNotStopTheRun` (`internal/engine`): a fake `slicer add` that exits 3 leaves the round going on, the run state as before and `file_error` set. Fails first: no filer.
- `TestToolFeedbackRepeatAcrossRunsReturnsTheSameItem` (`internal/engine`): a second run with the same proposal sends the same `--key`; the fake returns `existing: true, has_slice: true` and no `promote` runs. Fails first: no filer.

## Implement

1. Write the failing tests above and watch each go red for the reason given.
2. Key, slug and target functions; the record fields and the repeated-key skip.
3. `Client.Add`: send `--discovered-from` only when it is not empty.
4. `Deps.Project`, set in `runDeps`.
5. `FileToolFeedback` (stateless: project, item, run id, entries in; per-entry result out) and its call from `routeReport`; log writes through `e.wr`; never return its error to the round.

## Check

Acceptance criteria:

- After a run whose reviewer reports a 'friction' line for a registered tool, 'slicer show NEW --root TOOLPATH' shows the proposal as the title and a Why naming the role, run id, project, item and evidence.
- A 'friction' line for an unregistered tool files 'TOOL: PROPOSAL' in the run's own project, discovered from the run's item.
- The same proposal in a second run files nothing new: 'slicer find "PROPOSAL" --root TOOLPATH' lists one item.
- A 'feature' line files nothing; the run's 'run.json' 'tool_feedback' entry has its 'key'.
- A failing 'slicer add' leaves the run's state and verdict unchanged and 'file_error' set.
- Filing a later finding still sends '--discovered-from' (existing later-finding tests pass).
